description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Mobile Test Automation Engineer to design, develop and enhance scalable automation frameworks across mobile and API testing landscapes. This role offers the opportunity to work on Android and iOS applications, backend services, and modern CI/CD environments while contributing to quality engineering initiatives and exploring AI\-assisted test automation solutions. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in automation technologies, software development practices, and continuous quality improvement within Agile delivery teams.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, develop and maintain scalable, reusable test automation frameworks
* Develop automated test suites for functional, regression, integration, API and end\-to\-end testing
* Automate Android and iOS applications using Appium and relevant mobile automation technologies
* Develop and maintain API automation suites for backend systems and microservices
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing practices
* Analyse automation failures, identify root causes and collaborate with development teams to resolve issues efficiently
* Enhance the stability, scalability, maintainability and performance of automation frameworks
* Work closely with developers, product owners and QA teams to identify and mitigate quality risks early in the software delivery lifecycle
* Maintain automation documentation, coding standards and testing guidelines
* Explore and implement AI and LLM\-based solutions to improve automation effectiveness and testing efficiency
* Support performance, reliability and stability testing activities
* Evaluate emerging tools and technologies to continuously improve test coverage, quality and automation outcomes


**Who You Are**
* Strong programming experience in Java and/or Python
* Demonstrated expertise in Appium and Selenium automation frameworks
* Experience in mobile automation across Android and iOS platforms
* Hands\-on experience with Flutter application testing and Appium Flutter Driver
* Experience in API automation using REST Assured and Postman
* Knowledge of TestNG, JUnit, Cucumber, Behave or equivalent testing frameworks
* Strong understanding of Git, GitHub and/or GitLab, including branching strategies and code review practices
* Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar tools
* Familiarity with Gradle, Maven and build automation processes
* Good understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP protocols, OAuth2 authentication and API validation techniques
* Experience working with UiAutomator2 and mobile application debugging
* Knowledge of Docker and cloud\-based device platforms such as BrowserStack
* Working knowledge of AWS and cloud services
* Experience leveraging LLMs and AI\-assisted test automation capabilities
* Understanding of performance and reliability testing approaches
* Strong knowledge of Agile and Scrum methodologies
* Excellent analytical, debugging and problem\-solving skills


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to work with modern mobile, API and cloud testing technologies
* Exposure to large\-scale automation frameworks and continuous testing environments
* Collaboration with cross\-functional engineering, product and quality teams
* Opportunity to contribute to AI\-enabled quality engineering initiatives
* Experience working with industry\-leading DevOps and software delivery practices
* Exposure to enterprise\-scale applications and microservices ecosystems


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced mobile test automation across Android, iOS and Flutter applications
* Enterprise\-grade API automation and validation techniques
* CI/CD implementation and continuous testing best practices
* Cloud\-based testing using BrowserStack, Docker and AWS technologies
* AI and LLM\-driven test automation approaches
* Framework architecture, scalability and automation performance optimisation
* Quality engineering practices within Agile product delivery environments


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

title: Tools Development Engineer
description:
We are seeking a qualified Software Tools Development Engineer to join our GPU SWQA team. The successful candidate will have strong experience applying AI technologies to automate test cases and a deep understanding of Windows operating systems. Extensive knowledge of GPU, CPU, SoC, x86, and ARM architectures is required, along with expertise in PC I/O architecture and common bus interfaces such as PCIe, USB, and SATA. Familiarity with specifications for general PC architecture components is a plus.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Design and implement automated tests incorporating AI technologies for NVIDIA's device driver software and SDKs on windows platforms.
* Build tools/utility/framework in Python, C\# or equivalent which would help automate and optimize the testing workflows in GPU domain. Develop and implement automated and manual tests, analyze results, identify and report defects.
* Rigorously drive test automation initiative. Build innovative ways to automate and expand our software testing.
* Expose defects and constraints; Isolate and debug the issue(s) and find the root cause; Contribute to the solution and drive to closure. Measure code coverage for the software under test, analyze and drive code coverage enhancements.
* Develop applications and tools that accelerate development and test workflows and write fast, effective, maintainable, reliable and well documented code. Generate and test compatibility across a range of products and interfaces and validate different key software applications across a test matrix designed to test both breadth and depth.
* Provide peer code reviews including feedback on performance, scalability and correctness.
* Report test coverage and Go/No\-Go status for deliverables, escalate critical issues, and drive them to closure.
* Participate in root cause analysis and corrective actions to continuously improve deliverable quality, workflows, and processes.
* Effectively estimate and prioritize tasks in order to create a realistic delivery schedule.
* You will have the opportunity to work on challenging technical and process issues and work closely with leadership to report progress, generating effective and actionable reports.
* This is a fully onsite position.


**What We Need To See**
* B.S / B.Tech/M.S in Computer Science / Electronics \& Telecommunication with strong academics or equivalent experience.
* 3\+ years of programming experience in Python, C\# or equivalent with experience in applying Object\-Oriented Programming concepts.
* Hands\-on experience developing Python scripts using application development concepts like dictionaries, tuples, RegEx, PIP etc.
* Working experience with databases and storage technologies like SQL, MongoDB and Elasticsearch.
* Experience working on Windows OS with a solid understanding of GPU, CPU, and SoC architectures.
* Experience using AI tools to automate test cases as well as end\-to\-end QA workflow.
* Strong communication skills, including effective interpersonal and cross\-team collaboration.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Highly organized, proactive, and quick to learn.
* Ability to work effectively with engineering teams in a fast\-paced environment.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Strong problem\-solving skills, including the ability to apply sound logic when isolating and regressing issues, along with strong written communication skills.
* Extensive experience with AI\-driven automation.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in a distributed team environment.
* Development experience fixing regression bugs and implementing or enabling tests for CI/CD pipelines.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. title: Test Architect
description:
**Role:** 




 We're looking for a Test Architect to own our systems and integration testing strategy across complex, polyglot systems spanning C\+\+, Java and Python. Our test framework itself is written in Python, built on pytest, and we lean heavily on AI\-assisted development including Claude to build and extend it. You'll be the technical owner of that framework and the integration testing strategy behind it.
 



 This is a hands\-on architecture role, not a governance\-only position: you'll be writing Python/pytest day\-to\-day, building and evolving the framework, and working directly alongside engineers, while also acting as a client\-facing consultant understanding a stakeholder's technical challenges and driving the quality engineering roadmap that addresses them. Contract testing (e.g. Pact) is a useful tool in the kit, but it's a smaller part of the role than systems and integration testing
 



  





**Required Experience:** 



* 8\+ years as a Test Architect, Principal SDET, or senior test engineering leader, with proven ownership of systems/integration testing strategy for complex, distributed, polyglot systems.
* Strong hands\-on Python development with deep pytest expertise — building and maintaining test automation frameworks, not just writing test cases.
* Track record testing across service and process boundaries in polyglot environments spanning C\+\+, Java, and Python.
* Comfortable reading, and ideally writing, C\+\+ and Java alongside Python.
* Experience embedding automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, plus client\-facing consulting experience influencing senior stakeholders and shaping a test strategy roadmap.
* Open to work from Pune or Bengaluru location



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the systems and integration testing strategy across polyglot components (C\+\+, Java, Python), architecting suites that validate behaviour across service and process boundaries.
* Design, build and maintain the test automation framework in Python/pytest the backbone of how we test using AI\-assisted development tools (including Claude) to accelerate framework development and maintenance.
* Embed systems and integration tests into CI/CD pipelines, so breaking changes are caught before they reach production.
* Apply contract testing (e.g. Pact) selectively where it adds real value, as a complement to not a replacement for — the systems/integration test strategy.
* Partner directly with client engineering leaders to diagnose quality gaps, and propose and drive adoption of the tools, frameworks and practices that close them.
* Mentor and upskill engineers on Python/pytest test engineering and integration testing best practice, raising the quality bar across the wider team.
* Define and evolve the test automation roadmap for the engagement, balancing coverage, speed and maintainability.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Proven experience as a Test Architect, Principal SDET or similar, having designed and led systems/integration testing strategy for complex, distributed, polyglot systems.
* Strong, hands\-on Python skills with deep pytest expertise this is the language and framework the test suite is built on.
* A track record of testing across service and process boundaries in polyglot environments.
* Comfortable reading (and ideally writing) C\+\+ and Java, since the systems under test span both alongside Python.
* Enthusiasm for using AI coding assistants such as Claude to build and maintain test tooling and frameworks.
* Some exposure to contract testing (e.g. Pact) is a nice to have, and not the focus of the role.
* Experience embedding automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
* Confidence operating as a client\-facing consultant: comfortable influencing senior technical stakeholders and shaping strategy, not just executing against a backlog.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate testing strategy into business outcomes for both engineers and clients.
